text: 学习英语，打开梯子，看英文信息，对比来看，独立思考。
en: Learn English, use a VPN to get over the firewall, read English information, compare, and think independently.

text: 有人说国外也有信息茧房，其实这个事很好分辨，归根结底就是有没有人捂你的嘴。
en: Some say foreign countries also have information cocoons. Actually, this is easy to tell apart: it ultimately comes down to whether someone covers your mouth.

text: 就是说，你是否可以想说什么就说什么，想听什么就听什么？
en: That is: can you say whatever you want to say, and listen to whatever you want to listen to?

text: 你按自己的想法，观点，发个帖子，有没有一定概率被限流，折叠，删帖，封号。
en: If you post something according to your own ideas and views, is there a certain probability it will be throttled, collapsed, deleted, or your account banned?

text: 甚至请喝茶。
en: Or even being 'invited for tea'.

text: 你看了一个帖子，一篇文章，然后过几天这个帖子，文章消失了，荒原了。
en: You read a post, an article, and then a few days later that post, that article has disappeared, turned to wasteland.

text: 如果是这样，那么你一定是处于信息茧房中，毫无疑问。
en: If so, then you are definitely in an information cocoon, without a doubt.

text: 尽管你可能自以为知道很多事情，都没用，那就是信息茧房。
en: Even though you may think you know many things yourself, it is useless — that is the information cocoon.

text: 什么环境不是信息茧房呢？
en: What kind of environment is not an information cocoon?

text: 就是你发个帖子，文章，可能有赞同的，也有反对的，你可能被支持，也可能被骂。
en: It is when you post something, an article, and there may be people who agree and people who disagree; you may be supported, or you may be scolded.

text: 不同意你的观点的人或势力，也可能写一篇反对文驳斥你，甚至挖苦你，嘲笑你。
en: People or forces who disagree with your views may also write an article refuting you, or even mock you and laugh at you.

text: 但无论如何，你发出的帖子，文章永远都好好地在那里，没有任何东西能删你的贴，或者折你的叠，让你的帖子仅你自己可见，偷偷摸摸给你限流。
en: But in any case, the posts and articles you put out stay there properly forever. Nothing can delete your posts, or collapse your posts, making your posts visible only to yourself, or secretly throttle you.

text: 你的反对者可以反驳你，骂你，但是无法捂你的嘴，不让你说话。
en: Your opponents can refute you and scold you, but they cannot cover your mouth and stop you from speaking.

text: 那就不是信息茧房。
en: Then it is not an information cocoon.

text: 上知乎性别男
en: On Zhihu, set gender to male.

text: 上小红书改成性别女
en: On Xiaohongshu, change gender to female.

text: 完事
en: Done.

text: 突然的震惊！
en: Sudden shock!

text: 一位特朗普铁杆支持者、拥有近200万粉丝的保守派调查记者，竟公开承认“被俄罗斯宣传骗了多年”！
en: A staunch Trump supporter, a conservative investigative journalist with nearly 2 million followers, has publicly admitted to having 'been deceived by Russian propaganda for years'!

text: 最近，劳拉·卢默（Laura Loomer）的立场180度大转变，在国际社交媒体上引发热议。
en: Recently, Laura Loomer's stance has reversed 180 degrees, sparking heated discussion on international social media.

text: 她曾猛批乌克兰“充满纳粹辩护者”、泽连斯基是“圣战辩护者”，如今亲访乌克兰后却发文痛斥俄罗斯信息战，并保留所有旧帖作为证据。
en: She once fiercely criticised Ukraine as 'full of Nazi apologists' and Zelensky as a 'jihad apologist'; now, after personally visiting Ukraine, she has posted denouncing Russian information warfare, keeping all her old posts as evidence.

text: 这不是简单的网红大反转，而是一场现代地缘政治信息战的活教材。
en: This is not a simple influencer reversal, but a living textbook of modern geopolitical information warfare.

text: 俄罗斯精心编织的叙事，在铁一般的事实面前轰然崩塌。
en: Russia's carefully woven narrative has collapsed in the face of iron-clad facts.

text: 一起来看看，这位“Feisty Jewess”（她自称“强悍犹太女”）到底经历了什么！
en: Let us see what this 'Feisty Jewess' (as she calls herself, 'tough Jewish woman') actually went through!

text: 卢默是谁？
en: Who is Loomer?

text: MAGA圈的“敢死队”记者
en: The MAGA circle's 'daredevil' reporter.

text: 1993年出生，犹太裔美国人；
en: Born in 1993, a Jewish American;

text: 前Project Veritas卧底调查员，曾为多家保守媒体工作；
en: Former undercover investigator for Project Veritas, having worked for several conservative media outlets;

text: 特朗普坚定支持者，“America First”拥护者，X平台活跃网红；
en: A staunch Trump supporter, an 'America First' advocate, and an active influencer on the X platform;

text: 以大胆争议言论著称，常挑战主流媒体叙事。
en: Known for bold, controversial statements, often challenging mainstream media narratives.

text: 她长期在保守派圈子里传播反乌观点，甚至为俄罗斯国家媒体RT撰写过评论（虽未收钱）。
en: She long spread anti-Ukraine views in conservative circles, and even wrote commentary for the Russian state media RT (though unpaid).

text: 这一切，都源于她自己后来承认的——“生活在媒体回音室里，被俄罗斯社交媒体宣传洗脑”。
en: All of this stemmed from what she later admitted herself — 'living in a media echo chamber, brainwashed by Russian social media propaganda'.

text: 曾经的“硬核反乌”立场：俄罗斯宣传的忠实代言。
en: Her former 'hardcore anti-Ukraine' stance: a faithful spokesperson for Russian propaganda.

text: 过去几年，卢默反复宣称：
en: Over the past few years, Loomer repeatedly claimed:

text: 乌克兰是“充满纳粹辩护者的国家”；
en: Ukraine is a 'country full of Nazi apologists';

text: 反对美国对乌援助；
en: She opposed US aid to Ukraine;

text: 相信俄罗斯“去纳粹化”有理。
en: She believed Russia's 'denazification' was justified.

text: 这些观点精准契合克里姆林宫叙事，成功在西方保守派中制造分裂。
en: These views precisely matched the Kremlin narrative, successfully creating divisions among Western conservatives.

text: 她坦承：“我鹦鹉学舌般重复这些说法，以为自己在对抗全球主义，却没意识到被情感操纵。
en: She admitted: 'I parroted these claims, thinking I was fighting globalism, without realising I was being emotionally manipulated.

text: 信息战的高明之处就在于此——它不靠子弹，而是利用算法、回音室[1]、信息茧房[2]和地缘裂痕，让目标人群主动传播虚假信息。
en: The cleverness of information warfare lies precisely here — it does not rely on bullets, but uses algorithms, echo chambers [1], information cocoons [2] and geopolitical rifts to make target populations actively spread false information.

text: 她是怎么意识到自己可能被骗的？
en: How did she realise she might have been deceived?

text: 卢默的转变始于自我反思（2026年6月左右）：
en: Loomer's transformation began with self-reflection (around June 2026):

text: 她发现俄罗斯一边高喊“去纳粹化乌克兰”和“保护东正教基督徒”，一边却用导弹屠杀乌克兰平民、摧毁数百座教堂，并与车臣穆斯林部队合作进行“圣战式”屠杀。
en: She discovered that Russia, while shouting 'denazify Ukraine' and 'protect Orthodox Christians', was at the same time using missiles to massacre Ukrainian civilians, destroying hundreds of churches, and cooperating with Chechen Muslim troops in 'jihad-style' massacres.

text: 俄罗斯自称“东正教庇护者”，却支持美国本土新纳粹势力[3]、与伊朗结盟，这些巨大反差让她产生强烈认知失调。
en: Russia calls itself the 'protector of Orthodoxy', yet supports domestic American neo-Nazi forces [3] and allies with Iran. These huge contrasts gave her strong cognitive dissonance.

text: 她反思过去因“俄罗斯疲劳”（对特朗普“通俄门”反感的反弹）而过度同情俄罗斯，承认自己“戴上了玫瑰色眼镜”，落入了社交媒体和俄罗斯宣传的回音室。
en: She reflected that in the past, due to 'Russia fatigue' (a backlash against disgust with Trump's 'Russiagate'), she had over-sympathised with Russia, admitting she had 'put on rose-tinted glasses' and fallen into the echo chamber of social media and Russian propaganda.

text: 正是这一觉醒，让她决定不再被动接受叙事，而是主动求证。
en: It was precisely this awakening that made her decide to no longer passively accept narratives, but to actively seek verification.

text: 劳拉·卢默（Laura Loomer）亲自前往乌克兰验证俄罗斯的宣传
en: Laura Loomer personally travelled to Ukraine to verify Russian propaganda.

text: 亲访乌克兰：铁证如山，立场崩塌
en: Personal visit to Ukraine: iron-clad evidence, stance collapses.

text: 基于这一觉醒，2026年7月她批准制片人安德鲁·摩尔先去乌克兰前线报道，随后自己也亲自前往，目的是“亲眼看看这个国家，寻找我被灌输的宣传证据”，并准备“如果没找到，就告诉大家”。
en: Based on this awakening, in July 2026 she approved producer Andrew Moore going to the Ukraine front line to report first, and then went herself, with the aim of 'seeing this country with my own eyes, looking for evidence of the propaganda I was fed', and being prepared to 'tell everyone if I did not find it'.

text: 结果这一去就彻底粉碎了她先前带上的“玫瑰色眼镜”了。
en: As a result, this trip completely shattered the 'rose-tinted glasses' she had brought with her.

text: 她在布查等地亲眼看到：
en: In Bucha and other places, she saw with her own eyes:

text: 俄罗斯军队杀害神父的照片；
en: Photos of Russian soldiers killing priests;

text: 车臣部队制造的基督徒万人坑；
en: Mass graves of Christians created by Chechen troops;

text: 乌克兰战俘额头被刻上纳粹符号的证据。
en: Evidence of Ukrainian prisoners of war having Nazi symbols carved on their foreheads.

text: 她在X上发长文回应RT的嘲讽：
en: She posted a long article on X in response to RT's mockery:

text: “我确实说过那些话，但我不会删除旧帖，因为我意识到自己错了…
en: “I did say those things, but I won't delete my old posts, because I realised I was wrong…

text: 我被俄罗斯媒体宣传洗脑了。
en: I was brainwashed by Russian media propaganda.

text: 所以我来到乌克兰亲眼验证。
en: So I came to Ukraine to verify with my own eyes.

text: 第一天我就看到布查死去的神父、万人坑，以及战俘被刻纳粹符号的照片。
en: On the first day I saw dead priests in Bucha, mass graves, and photos of prisoners of war carved with Nazi symbols.

text: 谁才是纳粹？
en: Who are the Nazis?

text: 🤔 我被骗了多年。
en: 🤔 I was deceived for years.

text: 乌克兰和泽连斯基不是圣战辩护者…
en: Ukraine and Zelensky are not jihad apologists…

text: 俄罗斯和普京才是！
en: Russia and Putin are!

text: 俄罗斯非常擅长信息战。
en: Russia is very good at information warfare.

text: 她进一步指出：俄罗斯一边自称东正教保护者，一边屠杀乌克兰基督徒，还与伊斯兰激进势力结盟。
en: She further pointed out: Russia claims to be the protector of Orthodoxy on the one hand, while massacring Ukrainian Christians on the other, and allying with Islamic radical forces.

text: 信息战的残酷真相：俄罗斯叙事已破产
en: The brutal truth of information warfare: the Russian narrative has gone bankrupt.

text: 卢默的转变证明了三点：
en: Loomer's transformation proves three points:

text: 信息战比热战更隐蔽、更持久。
en: Information warfare is more covert and more enduring than hot war.

text: 即使是经验丰富的调查记者，也可能中招。
en: Even experienced investigative journalists can fall for it.

text: 回音室效应致命。
en: The echo chamber effect is deadly.

text: 单一信息源会扭曲认知。
en: A single information source distorts cognition.

text: 事实最终胜出。
en: Facts ultimately win.

text: 亲身调查+多元验证，是破解虚假宣传的利器。
en: Personal investigation plus diverse verification is a powerful tool for cracking false propaganda.

text: 俄罗斯的“去纳粹化”“自卫反击”等叙事，在布查铁证和卢默亲身经历面前彻底破产。
en: Russia's narratives of 'denazification' and 'self-defensive counterattack' have completely collapsed in the face of the Bucha iron-clad evidence and Loomer's personal experience.

text: 这也提醒我们：在复杂国际事务中，绝不能只听一面之词，不要陷入“信息茧房”。
en: This also reminds us: in complex international affairs, we must never listen to only one side, and must not fall into an 'information cocoon'.

text: 你怎么看这场大翻车？
en: What do you think of this big reversal?

text: 卢默是真心悔悟，还是另有算计？
en: Is Loomer genuinely repentant, or does she have other calculations?

text: 俄罗斯信息战在今天还有多大威力？
en: How powerful is Russian information warfare today?

text: 欢迎在评论区讨论！
en: Welcome to discuss in the comments section!

text: 点赞、转发、收藏，让更多人看到信息战的真相！
en: Like, share and save, so more people can see the truth about information warfare!

text: 参考
en: References

text: ^回音室（Echo Chamber）：指人们只接触与自己观点一致的信息，相互强化、不断“回音”，导致极端化和拒绝异见。
en: ^Echo Chamber: refers to people only coming into contact with information consistent with their own views, reinforcing each other and constantly 'echoing', leading to polarisation and rejection of dissent.

text: 强调群体内部放大和自我封闭。
en: It emphasises amplification within the group and self-enclosure.

text: ^信息茧房（Information Cocoon）：更强调算法推荐和个性化推送，让用户被“茧”裹住，只看到自己喜欢/同意的内容，逐渐与外界脱节。
en: ^Information Cocoon: places more emphasis on algorithmic recommendations and personalised pushes, wrapping users in a 'cocoon' so they only see content they like/agree with, gradually becoming disconnected from the outside world.

text: 侧重技术驱动的被动隔离。
en: It focuses on technology-driven passive isolation.

text: ^卢默在播客和帖文中反复提到的指控，但需要区分声明与证据：俄罗斯自称“东正教庇护者”：这是事实。
en: ^An accusation Loomer repeatedly mentioned in podcasts and posts, but claims must be distinguished from evidence: Russia calling itself the 'protector of Orthodoxy': this is a fact.

text: 普京多次将俄罗斯定位为全球东正教和传统基督教价值的守护者，反对西方“堕落”，并以此为入侵乌克兰的部分理由（“保护顿巴斯基督徒”等）。
en: Putin has repeatedly positioned Russia as the guardian of global Orthodox and traditional Christian values, opposing Western 'degeneracy', and used this as part of the justification for invading Ukraine ('protecting Donbas Christians' and so on).

text: 支持美国本土新纳粹势力：这是卢默的推论，她指出俄罗斯媒体/账号常放大或间接支持美国极右翼团体（包括部分有新纳粹背景的），尤其在反乌克兰、反犹太或反全球主义议题上。
en: Supporting domestic American neo-Nazi forces: this is Loomer's inference. She points out that Russian media/accounts often amplify or indirectly support American far-right groups (including some with neo-Nazi backgrounds), especially on anti-Ukraine, anti-Jewish or anti-globalist issues.

text: 俄罗斯还被指通过RT、社交媒体放大西方分裂，包括白人至上主义叙事，以制造混乱。
en: Russia is also accused of amplifying Western divisions through RT and social media, including white-supremacist narratives, to create chaos.

text: 客观事实层面：俄罗斯确实与全球极右翼/白人民族主义者有联系历史（如与某些欧洲极右政党往来）。
en: At the level of objective fact: Russia does have a history of connections with global far-right/white nationalist figures (such as dealings with certain European far-right parties).

text: 但“直接支持美国本土新纳粹”缺乏公开确凿的官方资助证据，更像是信息战中的相互利用：俄罗斯放大西方内部极端声音来削弱对手，美国部分极右也借俄罗斯平台发声。
en: But 'directly supporting domestic American neo-Nazis' lacks publicly conclusive evidence of official funding; it is more like mutual exploitation in information warfare: Russia amplifies extreme voices within the West to weaken its opponents, while some American far-right figures also use Russian platforms to speak out.

text: 卢默用此对比俄罗斯宣传的虚伪：一边宣称保护基督徒，一边在信息战中与/支持“实际新纳粹”合作。
en: Loomer uses this to contrast the hypocrisy of Russian propaganda: claiming to protect Christians on the one hand, while cooperating with/supporting 'actual neo-Nazis' in information warfare on the other.

text: 总结：这是卢默觉醒的关键矛盾点——宣传形象 vs 实际行为的反差，帮助她打破对俄罗斯的“玫瑰色滤镜”。
en: Summary: this is the key contradiction in Loomer's awakening — the contrast between propaganda image and actual behaviour, which helped her break through the 'rose-tinted filter' on Russia.

text: 是否“支持”仍存争议，但俄罗斯利用西方极右分裂是公认的信息战策略。
en: Whether it counts as 'support' remains disputed, but Russia's use of Western far-right divisions is a recognised information-warfare strategy.
